Legal notice and site presentation

This version presents the Beog-Zaadba private primary school project in Komsilga, Burkina Faso, for review by the promoter.

Editorial responsibility

The project owner described in the documents is Beog-Zaadba school, founded on the initiative of Yves Ferdinand KABORE. The legal entity, publisher and official contact details must be confirmed by school leadership before operational launch.

Sources and media

Text adapted from the brief dated 20 October 2026 and detailed budget calculated on 1 October 2026. Harmonised logos and audiovisual excerpt supplied with the school materials. Originals are retained. No role is attributed to the person appearing in the video.
